summary.display_result: Approximately 38.3 ms of native full-duplex application sample-grid waveform roundtrip in this configuration.
summary.scope: Repeatability observed in this program/configuration over two short, separately started streams and 40 timing probes. This does not establish long-term, cross-application, cross-buffer-setting, or calibrated absolute timing accuracy.
summary.percentile_warning: Within-run percentile spreads are descriptive statistics of integer-sample estimates. Interpolated percentiles can be below one sample and must not be reported as timing accuracy or independently established sub-sample jitter.

setup.interface: Audient iD14 MKII (CoreAudio name: Audient iD14)
setup.speakers: Edifier wired powered speaker pair; exact model not reverified during these runs
setup.microphone: Earthworks M50, identified during setup; connected to Audient microphone input 1

geometry.source: User reported approximately 10 cm earlier in this session.

unrecorded_controls: Exact monitor/output attenuation and speaker gain
setup.physical_output_assignment_note: The analysis does not independently establish which physical speaker received each host output channel.

estimand.name: native_full_duplex_source_to_microphone_waveform_roundtrip
estimand.start_coordinate: Sample position in the exact generated float32 output buffer submitted by the native duplex callback.
estimand.end_coordinate: Matching waveform position in recorded Audient microphone input 1, indexed by the same sequence of duplex callbacks.
estimand.sample_index_origin: Input and output array positions advance together in each full-duplex callback; matching indices are not assumed to represent simultaneous DAC and ADC events.
included_paths: Application/host output and input buffering under the tested duplex configuration
Acoustic propagation at the reported geometry
not_established: Isolated loudspeaker or physical DAC-to-ADC delay

stimulus.kind: locally specified nonperiodic timing probes; distinct from SONIC experimental stimuli
stimulus.waveform: 100 ms logarithmic sine chirp from 100 Hz toward 20 kHz
stimulus.frequency_endpoint_convention: 20 kHz instantaneous frequency at t=100 ms, immediately after the last sampled point
stimulus.ramp: 20 ms raised-cosine ramp at each end; a local choice
stimulus.amplitude_convention: Sine/chirp peak multiplier 10^(dBFS/20); not RMS or acoustic SPL

method.algorithm: Normalized waveform cross-correlation of each exact generated probe against the corresponding microphone search window; select the largest absolute correlation, permitting inverted polarity.
method.sample_interval_role: Search increment, not calibrated measurement accuracy.
method.transport_screen: Reject absent/failed native-acquisition metadata, inconsistent frame counts, nonfinite samples, callback error flags, and timestamp integrity failures. Host ADC/DAC timestamps remain uncalibrated diagnostics.
method.primary_lobe_role: The contiguous same-sign primary correlation lobe is excluded from the secondary-peak ambiguity check. Reported width is diagnostic, not a delay-uncertainty bound; overlapping paths within a lobe are unresolved.
method.trial_field_note: microphone_rms_fs is computed over the probe-length microphone search window extended by the maximum lag, as implemented in latency/analysis.py.

checks: Read raw arrays and canonical results without replaying audio
Confirmed the dominant peaks using a wider -100 to +200 ms source-to-microphone correlation search
Checked whole-capture clipping, callback status bits, and repeated-run waveform consistency
independent_read_only_review.result: Confirmed the two run medians and no stronger competing peak in the wider search. Strong and frequency-shaped microphone pickup supports the acoustic path; no speaker-disconnected isolation control was performed.

clock_diagnostics.interpretation: Host ADC/DAC timestamps are uncalibrated diagnostics. Primary source/microphone roundtrip uses paired full-duplex callback sample coordinates; timestamps and reported driver latencies are not added or subtracted.

limitations: Timing accuracy is uncalibrated. Integer-sample repeatability and correlation peak width do not establish absolute timing uncertainty.
Only two short stream starts in the current native application and settings were measured; buffer changes, sample-rate changes, device reconnects and other applications may change the result.
Waveform phase, filtering, room reflections and noise can move the correlation peak; this method does not independently identify first acoustic arrival.
The approximately 10 cm geometry is user reported and was not remeasured for these runs.
No calibrated sound-pressure measurement or exposure qualification was performed.
The stimulus range does not establish loudspeaker/microphone chain bandwidth, frequency-response calibration or 20 kHz performance.
These timing probes are not the paper SONIC stimulus; this record makes no claim of paper reproduction, neural response or animal readiness.
The earlier failed electrical-reference analysis remains a separate, invalid result for that method. Input 2 is not used as a reference here.
